scope: Source-preserving disk-domain atlas and conditional exact native reference export; no smooth fit or hidden geometry
selection: All unchanged 14,023 acquired faces in the eight frozen connected selections; no source point welding or deletion
contact_rule: Every closed triangle intersection must be exactly the simplex of their shared original vertex IDs. Positive-area overlap is forbidden. For a zero-area contact sharing one original vertex, a nonshared triangle vertex contained in the other projected closed triangle is forbidden.
arithmetic: Exact dyadic integers and independent Fraction predicates on inherited rounded binary64 UV charts; no physical/interval claim
partition_rule: Seed with the remaining face of minimum original ID. Repeatedly add the first admissible face in original-ID-sorted edge frontier. Its intersection with the current disk must be one connected boundary arc of one or two triangle edges; every already-present candidate vertex must belong to this arc. End a domain when no frontier face is admissible; repeat until every source face is assigned once.
domain_checks: single incident face fan at every domain vertex
cuts: Only existing original shared edges may become inter-domain boundaries; log both incident domain labels and original edge IDs privately
native_export: Only after all eight source/contact/domain checks pass; immutable retained native triangle constructor with original vertices, original triangles and disk labels as shell groups. Global original vertex and edge sharing within each region must survive actual STEP reload.
native_independent_checks: Unchanged independent source-shell inspector on every actual re-exported shell; independent global original vertex/edge uniqueness, shell membership and zero-solids checks. No fan split or new source coordinate.
native_is: Editable acquired-facet reference in STEP, not a smooth parametric head, closed body, qualified solver domain or fabrication job
